import ctypes

# Define a simple person structure using ctypes
class Person(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("name", ctypes.c_char * 50),
        ("age", ctypes.c_int),
        ("height", ctypes.c_float)
    ]

# Allocate memory for a Person object
person_ptr = ctypes.cast(ctypes.c_void_p(ctypes.pythonapi.malloc(ctypes.sizeof(Person))), ctypes.POINTER(Person))

# Example usage: accessing the allocated memory
if person_ptr:
    person_ptr.contents.name = b"John Doe"
    person_ptr.contents.age = 30
    person_ptr.contents.height = 5.9
    print(f"Name: {person_ptr.contents.name.decode()}, Age: {person_ptr.contents.age}, Height: {person_ptr.contents.height}")
else:
    print("Memory allocation failed")

    """
    Allocate a block of memory of the given size and return a pointer to the beginning of the block.
    
    Args:
        size (int): The size of the memory block to allocate in bytes.
    
    Returns:
        list: A list representing the allocated memory block.
    """

class Person:
    def __init__(self, name, age):
        self.name = name
        self.age = age

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Person(name='{self.name}', age={self.age})"

def allocate_and_copy(person):
    # تخصيص كتلة من الذاكرة بحجم sizeof(person)
    # في Python، لا نتعامل مباشرة مع الذاكرة، لكن يمكننا نسخ الكائن باستخدام التسلسل (serialization)
    # نستخدم نسخة عميقة (deep copy) لتمثيل تخصيص كتلة من الذاكرة ونسخ المحتويات
    import copy
    allocated_person = copy.deepcopy(person)
    return allocated_person

# مثال على الاستخدام
if __name__ == "__main__":
    original_person = Person("Ali", 30)
    copied_person = allocate_and_copy(original_person)
    print(copied_person)  # Person(name='Ali', age=30)

import ctypes

# Définition d'une structure person en Python
class Person(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("name", ctypes.c_char_p),
        ("age", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

def allocate_person():
    # Allouer un bloc de mémoire de taille sizeof(Person)
    person_ptr = ctypes.POINTER(Person)()
    person_ptr = ctypes.cast(ctypes.malloc(ctypes.sizeof(Person)), ctypes.POINTER(Person))
    
    # Vérifier si l'allocation a échoué
    if person_ptr is None:
        return None  # Équivalent à NULL en C
    
    return person_ptr

# Exemple d'utilisation
if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = allocate_person()
    if p is None:
        print("Erreur : allocation mémoire échouée.")
    else:
        print("Allocation réussie.")
        # Utilisation du pointeur (ex. : p.contents.name = b"John")
        p.contents.name = b"John"
        p.contents.age = 30
        print(f"Nom : {p.contents.name.decode()}, Âge : {p.contents.age}")
        # Libérer la mémoire
        ctypes.free(p)

def allocate_memory(size):
    # Create a block of memory of the specified size
    memory_block = bytearray(size)
    # Return a pointer (in Python, we use the memory address of the first byte)
    # Since Python doesn't have pointers like C, we use the memoryview to simulate it
    pointer = memoryview(memory_block).cast('B').tobytes()
    return pointer

import ctypes

class Person:
    def __init__(self, name="", age=0):
        self.name = name
        self.age = age

# Bellek ayırma yöntemi
def allocate_person_memory():
    # sizeof(person) boyutunda bir bellek bloğu ayır
    person_size = ctypes.sizeof(Person)
    # Bellek bloğunu ayır ve başlangıç adresini döndür
    ptr = ctypes.cast(ctypes.malloc(person_size), ctypes.POINTER(Person))
    return ptr

# Kullanım örneği
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Bellek ayır
    person_ptr = allocate_person_memory()
    
    # Bellek üzerinde veri yaz
    person_ptr.contents.name = "Ahmet"
    person_ptr.contents.age = 30
    
    # Veriyi oku
    print(f"İsim: {person_ptr.contents.name}, Yaş: {person_ptr.contents.age}")
    
    # Belleği serbest bırak
    ctypes.free(person_ptr)
